scope: Native Qt apps in disposable Xvfb container, not ISO/hardware acceptance

scenarios.name: calendar-create-edit
scenarios.detail: Actual event creation and editing persisted to local SQLite.

scenarios.name: calendar-ics-export
scenarios.detail: Actual save dialog exported .ics with UTF-8 notes and private permissions.

scenarios.name: calendar-delete-consent
scenarios.detail: Cancel preserves the event; explicit delete removes only that event.

scenarios.name: reuz-preferences
scenarios.detail: Timezone and format preferences saved; system clock not changed.

scenarios.name: reuz-countdown
scenarios.detail: Real Qt countdown pause/resume/completion; no physical audio or wake test.

scenarios.name: reuz-stopwatch
scenarios.detail: Default buttons start/pause, lap and reset the real stopwatch.

scenarios.name: native-theme-palettes
scenarios.detail: Real app renders both packaged palette definitions; this is app-level color testing, not a full Plasma-session theme switch.

scenarios.name: close-active-clock
scenarios.detail: Active-work warning is cancellable; confirmed close stops UI timers and leaves no background app.
